# Memory Palace

> A spatial learning app — drag memory nodes onto a 2D canvas, organise them into rooms inside palaces, and review with spaced repetition.

Memory Palace combines the classic method-of-loci memorisation technique with a modern spaced-repetition engine. Users build a palace of rooms; rooms hold nodes; nodes are reviewed via flashcards, multiple-choice, or typed recall. Bible mode adds chapter/verse semantics for scripture memorisation.
